Anya (DevEx): Quick sync — devex release v1.5 changelog freeze at 18:00 PT today. Need final owners for SDK, docs, quickstarts, and sampleapps. Post ETA or /satisfied. :alarm_clock:

Marco K (SDK): I'm on a breaking rename: REDWOOD_CLIENT -> RW_CLIENT_KEY in the SDK. PR: github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/510. Tests failing in the windows-latest matrix on the auth shim (401). Investigating, ETA ~45m.

Lina P (Docs): Hold for env var name. Will update quickstart snippets and the migration note once confirmed. Also I have a TOC conflict on the getting-started page.

CI Bot: matrix/windows-latest failed on auth-test: traceback shows HTTP 401 for auth.get_token. Logs: https://ci.redwood.example/job/510/8

Theo M (SampleApps): I'll run linux-x86 and mac-arm smokes after Marco merges. Also need to update dockerfile CMD with new env name.

Marco K (SDK): Found bad default in the auth shim that wasn't reading RW_CLIENT_KEY from env. Pushing fix, rerunning tests.

DevEx Bot: changelog-freeze: will lock changelog at 18:00 PT for release/v1.5. Any edits after freeze require `release-leads` approval.

Marco K (SDK): Tests green. Merging and opening cherry-pick to release/v1.5: github.com/redwood/release/pull/201. Adding migration note to changelog/diffs/510.md

Lina P (Docs): Updating snippets and TOC now. Will open docs PR and reference sdk#510. ETA ~20m.

Theo M (SampleApps): Smokes passing on linux-x86, mac-arm still flaky on startup race — increasing timeout fixes it locally. I'll push that tweak and run CI.

Priya S (Releases): If mac-arm flake persists, we can exclude it from the gate and run post-cut verification; call it out by 17:30 PT. Cherry-picks must be opened by 17:45 PT for manual review.

Theo M (SampleApps): Pushed timeout bump. CI now green. Sampleapps PR merged and README updated to RW_CLIENT_KEY.

Lina P (Docs): Docs PR up: docs#782, includes RW_CLIENT_KEY examples and migration note. TOC conflict resolved.

Marco K (SDK): Cherry-pick opened and merged into release/v1.5. CI Bot: sdk#510 backport PR checks passed.

Release Bot: changelog-freeze engaged for release/v1.5 at 18:00 PT. Tagging release manager.

Anya (DevEx): Ownership recap: SDK Marco, Docs Lina, SampleApps Theo, Releases Priya. Please post /satisfied when your merge and backport are done.

Marco K (SDK): /satisfied

Lina P (Docs): :white_check_mark: merged

Theo M (SampleApps): /satisfied — smokes and readme updated

Priya S (Releases): Backports in and PRs linked. We're good from releases.

Anya (DevEx): Great job. I'll run the post-cut checklist at 18:05 PT. If anything comes up, reopen this thread.
